name: Wicked Howl raises maximum health by 30% for its duration (#3365)
contract: Wicked Howl 804207 has a single effect in Spell.dbc: SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with aura 133 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_HEALTH_PERCENT, BasePoints 29 + DieSides 1 = 30%, duration index 8 (15000 ms) and RecoveryTime 120000. The native handler is AuraEffect::HandleAuraModIncreaseHealthPercent. The bindmysoul snapshot says 20 seconds where the shipped duration index gives 15; the installed DBC wins. 804207 carries CasterAuraSpell 525031, one of the two Cursed Form markers AscensionBloodmageTalents.cpp mirrors onto the real form state, so the caster is given that marker as a fixture.

steps.label: The buff runs no longer than its shipped 15 seconds
Maximum health returns to its baseline
